⚡ Amazon A10 vs Legacy A9 Algorithmic Architecture

How Amazon's next-generation search engine prioritizes organic sales, conversion rate, customer trust, and mobile CTR

Algorithmic Shift
Algorithmic Vector Legacy A9 Search Engine Next-Gen A10 Search Engine Our Strategic Optimization
Organic Sales Weight Moderate weight; equal to PPC sales velocity 2.5x heavier weight than PPC; rewards organic CVR Front-loaded mobile titles & objection-killing bullets drive natural conversions
PPC Dependence & Bleed High ad spend could artificially boost ranking Low-converting clicks actively damage organic rank score PPC Bleeder Shield isolates 18 negative exact cuts to protect overall listing CVR
Mobile Title Truncation 200-character desktop keyword stuffing Strict ≤ 75 char titles; mobile app truncates past 70 chars All 16 titles front-load Brand + Core Product + Pack/Size in ≤ 75 characters
Backend Keyword Indexing Loose counting, repeated title words tolerated Strict ≤ 249 UTF-8 bytes; ignores duplicate words Zero-waste deduplication against customer-facing copy reserves bytes for high-intent synonyms
Customer Return Rate Penalty Minimal direct organic ranking impact High return rates (> 10%) trigger severe organic demotion Bullets specify exact dimensions, capacity (200g-350g), and material to prevent remorse
Search Intent Specificity Broad keyword density and matching Semantic clusters, exact match intent, regional Hindi/Hinglish Harvested 3,249 authentic Indian customer queries including festive search terms

PPC Bleeder Shield & Bid Optimization Engine

Isolate 18 zero-order bleeding terms to instantly save ₹4,144/month and scale the top 10 profitable exact targets.

💡
Why A10 Demands Negative Keyword Shielding:

Under Amazon's A10 search engine, organic search rankings are heavily tethered to listing conversion rate (CVR). When broad or automated PPC campaigns accumulate clicks without conversions, the overall listing CVR drops, prompting A10 to lower your organic keyword rankings. Negating zero-order bleeders directly shields organic listing CVR and preserves seller authority.
